# Case Study: Seattle House Prices
We will create a multiple regression model for inference.

## Exploratory Data Analysis
EDA has three main steps:

  * Looking a the raw data values.
  * Computing summary statistics.
  * Creating data visualizations.

We start with a look a the raw data:
```{r}
glimpse(house_prices)
```

The data set has `{r} format(nrow(house_prices), big.mark = ',')` entries and `{r} ncol(house_prices)` varibales, one of which is an ID column that is not really informational.

Let's look at all the numeric varibles:
```{r}
house_prices |>
  tidy_summary(where(is.numeric))
```
